visual.pie: Sea otters: a keystone species that protects kelp forests

turnos.t: Not necessarily. Stabilisation may reflect falling fertility and ageing, not a resource ceiling, and a stable population can still be unsustainable if consumption per person keeps rising. A projection is not a limit.

A species with a disproportionately large effect on its ecosystem relative to its abundance. Remove it and you get a trophic cascade. Sea otters eat sea urchins; without otters, urchins overgraze the kelp and the kelp forest collapses. And biosphere integrity is beyond its boundary: at least 100 extinctions per million species-years, against a safe limit under 10.
